name: Wikimon
summary:
Wikimon is a collectible card game played in the browser in which popular Wikipedia articles become cards.
Players open booster packs to build their collection, assemble decks, and trade copies with each other on a player-driven market of fixed-price listings and auctions.

Battles are fought through trivia: each round asks questions written from the articles of the cards in play.

Available in English / French : Each language is a separate edition of the game, with its own cards, economy and rankings.
